cd /app/tmp/work && cat > mags.py <<'PY'
import sys,json,subprocess,random
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker
def make(rng):
    n=rng.randint(3,10); m=rng.randint(n,3*n)
    edges=[]
    for _ in range(m):
        t=rng.randrange(n);h=rng.randrange(n)
        while h==t:h=rng.randrange(n)
        edges.append({"tail":t,"head":h,"capacity":rng.choice([1,7,512,1024])})
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid,e in enumerate(edges):adj[e["tail"]].append((eid,e["head"]))
    def paths(s,t,cnt):
        r=[]
        for _ in range(cnt*10):
            if len(r)>=cnt:break
            cur=s;pa=[];vis={s};ok=False
            for _ in range(n+1):
                if cur==t:ok=True;break
                o=[x for x in adj[cur] if x[1] not in vis]
                if not o:break
                eid,h=rng.choice(o);pa.append(eid);vis.add(h);cur=h
            if ok and cur==t and pa and pa not in r:r.append(pa)
        return r
    comms=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,6)):
        s=rng.randrange(n);t=rng.randrange(n)
        while t==s:t=rng.randrange(n)
        ps=paths(s,t,rng.randint(1,3))
        if not ps:continue
        cuts=sorted(rng.randint(0,16) for _ in range(len(ps)-1))
        prev=[];last=0
        for c in cuts+[16]:prev.append(c-last);last=c
        comms.append({"source":s,"target":t,"demand":rng.choice([1,7,512,1024]),"paths":ps,"previous":prev})
    return {"epoch":rng.randint(0,2**31-1),"node_count":n,"edges":edges,"commodities":comms,"failed_edges":[],"budget":rng.choice([0,1,100,98304])}
rng=random.Random(2024)
reqs=[make(rng) for _ in range(500)]
data=b"".join((json.dumps(r)+"\n").encode() for r in reqs)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
outs=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines()]
maxmag=0;nfail=0;stat={}
for req,o in zip(reqs,outs):
    stat[o.get("status")]=stat.get(o.get("status"),0)+1
    e,_=checker.check(req,o)
    if e: nfail+=1; print("FAIL",e[:2],json.dumps(req)[:200],json.dumps(o)[:200]) if nfail<=3 else None
    if o.get("status")=="optimal" and o.get("dual"):
        maxmag=max(maxmag,max(abs(v) for v in o["dual"]["inequality"]+o["dual"]["equality"]) if (o["dual"]["inequality"] or o["dual"]["equality"]) else 0)
    if o.get("status")=="infeasible" and o.get("certificate"):
        c=o["certificate"]["inequality"]+o["certificate"]["equality"]
        maxmag=max(maxmag,max(abs(v) for v in c) if c else 0)
print("stats",stat,"fails",nfail,"max cert magnitude",maxmag)
